summary: Casanéo iteration 16 (retest after canSeePrices admin bypass fix in /app/frontend/src/permissions.ts). Frontend-only verification with QA admin (qa.admin@casaneo.test / role=member, member_role=admin). Pre-conditions set via backend PUT /api/properties/{id}: property Cosy Cocoon (d4b761bc…) → default_cleaning_fee=60, default_tourist_tax=3; property Chic & Cosy (f28dec85…) → default_cleaning_fee=80, default_tourist_tax=5. UI flow: login via 'Se connecter avec un email et un mot de passe' → /calendar (Réservations) → add-reservation-fab → reservation-form. Results: (1) 'Tarifs' section is NOW VISIBLE for the admin member — cleaning-fee & tourist-tax fields render (canSeePrices fix confirmed). (2) Selecting Cosy Cocoon pre-fills cleaning-fee='60' and tourist-tax='3' as expected. (3) Switching to Chic & Cosy updates the two fields to '80' and '5' respectively (setProperty pre-fill path L156-173 works). (4) Switching back to Cosy Cocoon updates them back to '60' and '3' (round-trip OK). All defaults restored to original (0/0) after the test. No react-native / deprecated-package issues detected in the touched code paths.
critical_code_review_comments: reservation-form.tsx L129-130 & L168-169 still uses truthy check `p.default_cleaning_fee ? String(...) : f.cleaning_fee`. A property with default=0 would fall back to the previous field value instead of showing '0'. Low priority (0 is semantically 'no default'), but consider `p.default_cleaning_fee != null` for robustness (already flagged in iter15).
permissions.ts canSeePrices() admin bypass is consistent with canModify() — good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 assertions: P1 pre-fill, P2 update on change, round-trip back to P1)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily set default_cleaning_fee/default_tourist_tax on two existing properties (Cosy Cocoon: 60/3, Chic & Cosy: 80/5) via PUT /api/properties/{id}. Both restored to 0/0 at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified. To reproduce: login qa.admin@casaneo.test / CasaneoQA2026! → navigate to /calendar → tap add-reservation-fab → in res-prop-picker select a property that has default_cleaning_fee/default_tourist_tax set → assert testID cleaning-fee & tourist-tax inputs equal those defaults; then select another property with different defaults and re-check values update.
rca_of_issue: Fix applied at /app/frontend/src/permissions.ts:146 — canSeePrices() now returns true early when memberRole(user)==='admin', mirroring canModify(). This unblocks the Tarifs section render (reservation-form.tsx:398) for member=admin users whose permissions array is empty, and lets the default-fees pre-fill (L129-130 initial load, L156-173 on picker change) be observed and edited in the UI.
